name: mise
description: See and add Mise events, and check leads, proposals and rooms. Sign in with your Mise account.

interface.longDescription: Mise is the event system for restaurants and venues. Connect it to see what's on the calendar and add events, check which leads still need a reply and which proposals are active, and see whether a room is free. When you add an event, the assistant asks what kind of event it is and only what's missing, suggests answers from past bookings, and checks with you before saving. It can't delete anything or send messages. An owner or manager signs in with their Mise account and can disconnect the assistant anytime in Mise under Settings, AI assistants.
